facts.statement: Larkspur Data is a fictional B2B software company, founded in 2019, that provides a cloud customer-data platform for regulated industries.
Larkspur Data has approximately 240 employees across offices in Denver, USA and Dublin, Ireland.
Larkspur supports single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect, tested with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace.
Larkspur provides role-based access control with built-in roles (Admin, Editor, Analyst, Viewer) and customer-defined custom roles.
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 using keys managed in AWS KMS.
All data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.2 or higher.
Larkspur holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, available to prospective customers under NDA.
Larkspur is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022; the certificate was issued in October 2025.
An independent third party performs a penetration test of the Larkspur platform at least once a year; an executive summary of the latest test is available under NDA.
Larkspur records audit logs of user and administrator actions, retains them for 12 months, and customers can export them via the API.
Larkspur is hosted on AWS. Customers choose a US region (us-east-1) or an EU region (eu-central-1, Frankfurt), and customer data stays in the chosen region.
Customer data is backed up daily, backups are encrypted and retained for 35 days, and a copy is stored in a second region within the same geography.
Larkspur's disaster-recovery objectives are a recovery point objective (RPO) of 1 hour and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 4 hours; the plan is tested annually.
On contract termination, Larkspur deletes customer data within 30 days, and customers can request a full data export before deletion.
Larkspur offers a GDPR data processing agreement (DPA) and publishes its list of subprocessors on its trust page.
Larkspur notifies affected customers of a confirmed security breach involving their data within 72 hours of confirmation.
Larkspur's standard SLA commits to 99.9% monthly uptime for the production platform, with service credits if it is missed.
Support is available 24/7 for severity-1 incidents and during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm in the customer's region) for other issues, via a support portal and email.
A typical implementation takes 6 to 8 weeks and is led by a dedicated Larkspur implementation manager.
Larkspur provides a documented REST API and prebuilt connectors for Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon S3 and Salesforce.
Larkspur ingests data in batches through its connectors and the REST API, on schedules as frequent as every 15 minutes.
